PatchData.Title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time [Subset - Glitch Showcase]

Achievements.Title: Warning: Outdated Emulator (please update)
Achievements.Description: Hardcore unlocks cannot be earned using this version of this emulator.

Achievements.Title: Please Take Good Care of It
Achievements.Description: Obtain an ocarina for the first time as an adult.

Achievements.Title: Deku Tree - B Button Challenge
Achievements.Description: Complete the Deku Tree without ever pressing B. (SEE COMMENTS)
Achievements.Author: SlashTangent

Achievements.Title: Dodongo's Cavern - B Button Challenge
Achievements.Description: Complete Dodongo's Cavern without ever pressing B. (SEE COMMENTS)

Achievements.Title: Jabu Jabu - B Button Challenge
Achievements.Description: Complete Jabu Jabu without ever pressing B. (SEE COMMENTS)

Achievements.Title: Aren't You a Bit Big to Be Here?
Achievements.Description: Defeat Queen Gohma as an Adult.

Achievements.Title: Item Swap
Achievements.Description: Defeat Barinade as an Adult.

Achievements.Description: Escape Kokiri Forest WITHOUT beating the Deku Tree first.

Achievements.Description: Enter Jabu-Jabu's belly without feeding him a fish.

Achievements.Description: Win the Chest Mini-Game grand prize without using the Lens of Truth.

Achievements.Description: Obtain the Gold Scale as a child.

Achievements.Description: Play a burning deku stick as an ocarina and let it burn down.

Achievements.Title: Dive Dive Dive!
Achievements.Description: Enter the Bottom of the Well as a child before draining the well.

Achievements.Title: Dampe Time Paradox
Achievements.Description: As a child complete the Dampe race and obtain the Hookshot.

Achievements.Title: New Boot Goofin
Achievements.Description: As a child obtain the hoverboots from the Shadow Temple.

Achievements.Description: Obtain the Heart Piece above the graveyard as a child.

Achievements.Description: Obtain the mythical 37th heart piece in Gerudo Valley

Achievements.Title: Door of Time Skip
Achievements.Description: Become an adult without opening the Door of Time.

Achievements.Description: Become a child again while the Door of Time is still closed. (Must start on the Stone Pedestal Side)

Achievements.Title: HP Over Dodongo
Achievements.Description: Collect the HP over Dodongo's cavern without planting the bean plant.

Achievements.Description: Enter Zora's Domain from Zora's River without playing Zelda's Lullaby to open the waterfall.

Achievements.Description: As an adult steal Epona from Lon Lon Ranch without winning the race against Ingo.

Achievements.Description: Unfreeze King Zora without using Blue Fire.

Achievements.Description: Cross the broken Gerudo Valley bridge without Epona or the Longshot.

Achievements.Description: Warp Epona to the island above the water temple using a warp song

Achievements.Description: Enter the Ganon's castle climb without breaking the barrier.

Achievements.Title: I Need to Ask Chu a Question
Achievements.Description: Defeat King Dodongo using only Bombchus as your explosive.
Achievements.Author: SlashTangent

Achievements.Title: Gatekeeping
Achievements.Description: From Gerudo's Fortress enter the Haunted Wasteland without raising the gate first.

Achievements.Title: This Isn't a Randomizer?
Achievements.Description: Enter the Deku Tree as an Adult.

Achievements.Description: Enter the Water Temple before shooting the gem to open the gate.
Achievements.Author: SlashTangent

Achievements.Title: Bullseye!
Achievements.Description: Shoot the Water Temple Gate Gem in Lake Hylia without equipping the Iron Boots.
Achievements.Author: SlashTangent

Achievements.Title: Just Walk Right Up To It
Achievements.Description: Obtain the Heart Piece in the Death Mountain Crater Smoke Stack without planting the bean plant.
Achievements.Author: SlashTangent

Achievements.Title: The Bottle is Mightier Than the Sword
Achievements.Description: Equip a Bottle on B
Achievements.Author: SlashTangent

Achievements.Title: Theater Skull
Achievements.Description: Obtain the gold skulltula token above the deku theater without planting the bean.
Achievements.Author: SlashTangent

Achievements.Title: What a Horrible Night for a Curse
Achievements.Description: Obtain 101 Golden Skultula Tokens
Achievements.Author: SlashTangent

Achievements.Title: No Rainbow Bridge
Achievements.Description: Enter Ganon's Castle without activating the Rainbow Bridge
Achievements.Author: SlashTangent

Achievements.Title: I Ain't Afraid of No Ghost
Achievements.Description: Enter the Forest Temple's Boss without obtaining the boss key and without killing all four poes.
Achievements.Author: SlashTangent

Achievements.Title: The Biggerest Quiver
Achievements.Description: Hold the Archery Minigame NPC Above your head in victory!
Achievements.Author: SlashTangent

Achievements.Title: Ass Chest
Achievements.Description: Obtain the Spooky Mask in Gerudo's Fortress from the Archery Minigame
Achievements.Author: SlashTangent

Achievements.Title: Mr. Zfg1's Wild Ride
Achievements.Description: Obtain 37 keys in the water temple
Achievements.Author: SlashTangent
